items.question: Who is this My Monthly for?
items.answer:
My Monthly is designed for anyone who wants to better understand and navigate menstrual cycles. Whether you menstruate yourself, have a partner who does, or just want to learn more.

Our goal is to make cycle awareness, communication, and support simple and accessible for couples, friends, and individuals alike.

items.question: Is it available on iOS and Android?
items.answer: My Monthly is available on iOS and will be available on Android later this year! Stay tuned for updates!

items.question: I’d love to collaborate with My Monthly for an Event, who do I contact?
items.answer: We’d love to hear from you! Please reach out to our partnerships team at hello@mymonthly.co, and we’ll explore ways to work together on events, content, or special campaigns.
